improvement.name: Playwright 1.63.0-alpha-2026-08-21 qualification
improvement.problem: Ferrum's verified toolchain remained on the Aug-20 Playwright 1.63 alpha after the Aug-21 next build became available.
implementation: Advance Playwright and playwright-core to exact 1.63.0-alpha-2026-08-21 through an authoritative npm-resolved lockfile.
Preserve the already-qualified Opera GX Playwright compatibility repair without widening it to other browsers.
Retain immutable GitHub Action SHA pins, frozen installs, all browser/app targets, evidence, restart, packaging, mobile, WebDriver and Tauri coverage.
Remove the verification-in-progress Stack candidate marker only after exact-head qualification and merge.
acceptance: Authoritative lock resolves Playwright and playwright-core exactly to 1.63.0-alpha-2026-08-21.
Ferrum CI remains fully green across Linux/Windows Chromium, Chrome, Edge, MV3, Workbench, Electron, desktop package/provenance, Selenium Grid, Brave, Opera GX, Lightpanda and Android/Appium.
Native Windows, Tauri WebDriver, service fixture, stateful API and network-fault companion workflows pass on the exact proposal head.
Merged product tree is byte-identical to the exact tested proposal tree.

coverage: unit tests, syntax, shell checks, MCP surface and independent MCP Inspector, evidence integrity
independent Brave and Opera GX, real Selenium Grid WebDriver, Lightpanda and real Android/Appium
real embedded and official-reference Tauri WebDriver paths on Linux and Windows

risk.summary: Playwright remains a prerelease forward line; daily browser/protocol changes can still expose new incompatibilities.
risk.rollback: Revert the coherent Playwright manifest/lock/candidate-state change to the verified Aug-20 line only if a later exact runtime regression cannot be fixed forward.
